title: GC18R-R1 Independent Architecture Audit

invariants.assessment: Single shared groundwater exchange service contract; no use-case-specific kernel fork.
No files, parsers, formats, paths or file units in the runtime contract.
Checkpoint, candidate, prepared reservation and result remain explicit transaction categories.
Reservation registry exists only on preparable service objects and scales with peak concurrent reservations, not logical columns.
No solver scratch is made persistent per column.
Free-list reserve/release is O(1) with amortized geometric growth and does not constrain batch/SoA layouts.
Independent copied-handle probes prove stale commit/abort are rejected before backend callbacks and committed state is not changed by abort.
Prepare refusal and abort preserve the committed origin; retry from the same physical committed state remains possible.
Generic t0/t1 coupling windows are retained; no calendar unit is introduced.
No fixed window duration or midnight boundary is introduced.
Prepare, abort, irreversible publication and replay protection are explicit coupling runtime semantics.
F-GC17 typed head/flux contract blob is unchanged; q_GW=-q_SWAP and q residual convention are preserved.
No mass tolerance exists in the service. Exactly-once publication is independently proven against copied handles and token reuse.
No response-tangent or interface-sensitivity path is removed or constrained.
No extra full SWAP trajectories are introduced by the remediation.
No heavy instance per column; reservation state is pooled and optional. No throughput benchmark is claimed.
No one-to-one MODFLOW-cell assumption is encoded.
Deep-vadose component ownership is untouched.
No transfer-zone accounting rule is changed; duplicate publication is prevented.
Groundwater transaction service is independent of soil-water solver implementation.
No crop, ET, drainage, irrigation or surface physics is duplicated.
No HeadCalc internals are exposed.
Transaction safety is runtime contract behavior and does not silently change physical options.
Revision exhaustion fails closed; reservation lookup is bounded O(1) apart from amortized growth.
Reference-mode physics is unchanged and base F-GC18 regression remains green.
Explicit stale-prepared and revision-exhausted statuses make failure mode diagnosable.
Non-preparable services allocate no reservation registry; optional cost scales with use.
Runtime/coupler retains system composition and exclusive ownership of mutations to one service instance is explicit.
No silent file, calendar, MODFLOW or revision-headroom dependency remains in the qualified contract.
Independent F-VQ61 rechecks all 30 invariants and preserves F-VQ60 as frozen blocked evidence rather than rewriting history.

limitations: No MODFLOW adapter or groundwater physics is qualified by this work unit.
No end-to-end predictor-corrector convergence, process-crash recovery or distributed transaction protocol is qualified.
No large-MultiSWAP throughput benchmark is claimed.
Hard mass verdict is limited to the typed interface and exactly-once transaction publication contract; physical aquifer closure remains an end-to-end integration responsibility.
